name: Gram Gold
oneLiner: GRAMG is Token Teknoloji's gram-gold stablecoin, minted 1:1 against on-chain PAXG reserves and targeting one gram of gold value per token.
collateral: Each GRAMG is directly collateralized by PAXG held on-chain as reserve collateral; GRAMG is minted and burned as equivalent PAXG is added to or removed from the reserve wallet. The underlying PAXG is gold-backed through Paxos custody, while Token Teknoloji also discloses physical-gold reserve claims including Turkish Central Bank custody.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint/redeem and exchange conversion route for a one-gram gold claim; public materials support reserve backing but do not expose a reviewed direct holder redemption schedule suitable for a Pharos backstop config

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GRAMG uses Token Teknoloji issuer-native StableCoin contracts on Avalanche and Polygon. Direct source verification resolves externalTransfer/externalTransferFrom burn/mint functions controlled by the issuer supply manager, so the previous Across/Avalanche route signal is not the durable supply path.
